name: Vasicine
traditionalUse: Widely used as a bronchodilator and expectorant in herbal cough remedies.
description: A quinazoline alkaloid extracted from the leaves of Justicia adhatoda.

name: Asiaticoside
traditionalUse: Memory enhancement, wound healing, and blood circulation support.
description: A major active triterpenoid saponin extracted from Gotu Kola leaves.

name: Berberine
traditionalUse: Traditional remedy for fevers, wound disinfection, and stomach ailments.
description: A quaternary ammonium salt from the protoberberine group of isoquinoline alkaloids found in Venivel.

name: Nimbin
traditionalUse: Natural antiseptic, skin protection, and pest-repellent formulations.
description: A biologically active triterpenoid extracted from neem tree leaves and seeds.

name: Cinnamaldehyde
traditionalUse: Carminative, blood sugar regulation, and antimicrobial spice compound.
description: The organic compound that gives true Ceylon cinnamon its distinctive smell and flavor.

name: Aloin
traditionalUse: Soothing skin burns, wound care, and gentle digestive support.
description: A bitter, yellow-brown colored compound found in Aloe vera exudate.

name: Curcumin
traditionalUse: Powerful anti-inflammatory agent, joint health, and immunity booster.
description: The principal curcuminoid of turmeric, widely used in traditional medicine and cuisine.

name: 6-Gingerol
traditionalUse: Relief from nausea, digestive discomfort, and cold symptoms.
description: The active pungent constituent of fresh ginger rhizome with antioxidant properties.

name: Emblicanin A
traditionalUse: Rejuvenator (Rasayana), rich source of Vitamin C, cellular protection.
description: A potent antioxidant polyphenol isolated from Indian Gooseberry (Nelli).

name: Arjunic Acid
traditionalUse: Cardioprotective tonic, heart health, and wound healing.
description: A pentacyclic triterpenic acid extracted from the bark of the Kumbuk tree.
